paragraph: Firms in Angola reported [2.37 outages in a typical month](<https://www.enterprisesurveys.org/en/data>) in the World Bank's Enterprise Survey for 2024. The survey counts the outages firms report and says nothing of how long each lasted. No earlier survey has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No figure of 2 or fewer outages a month has been found, and no regulator's or utility's interruption figure for 2023 or later. Operating would need two outages a month or fewer.

Minutes of a July 2026 validation meeting [give 1.26 a month by the operator Socadel's reckoning](<https://ecomatin.net/cameroun-coupures-delectricite-126-heures-par-client-en-2025-selon-larsel-46-heures-selon-socadel>), and the two sides did not agree.
